title: Australia Chain David Jones Collapses After Almost 200 Years
summary: Australia’s oldest department store David Jones collapsed on Thursday, finally succumbing after almost 200 years as the digital era drove shoppers to cheaper and nimbler online rivals.

title: DBS Profit Misses Estimates on Trading Drop, Names Lim Chair
